digest.component_or_area: review-bot ticket clone persistence and deployment bootstrap
propositions: EBS-backed persistent tickets clone is not refreshed on redeploy because entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, leaving divergent history intact

ensure-tickets script must fetch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets and converge using reconverge for equal, behind, ahead, and same-epoch divergent states while preserving local-only commits

pre-epoch local clones with prior-remote ancestor lineage must adopt pinned fetched epoch-bearing remote commits only when preconditions prove no local-only commits exist; all other mismatches must preserve local tip and emit operator warnings
deploy path autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh so script changes do not trigger redeployment
convergence must remain best-effort outside PAT block and never undo or wedge already-cast Gerrit votes; failed fetch must exit success with warning and preserve local tip
